com.colony_seasons.building.decorator.de: Home of the Decorator. All year he asks the warehouse for leaves, string, dye and lights and makes wreaths, garlands and strings of lights, so they are ready when a festival comes. A higher hut keeps more of each in stock.
com.colony_seasons.building.townsquare.d: The colony's square. The Decorator decorates it for the festivals; he stays employed at his Workshop.
One Decorator works this square. He stays employed at his Workshop.
com.minecolonies.coremod.setting.tooltip: Follow the calendar: the set of the festival whose decoration window is open. Always Winter Festival: the winter set in every festival window. Bare: no set. The festivals take place on the square under every choice.
colony_seasons:decorator.job.desc: Makes the colony's festival decorations from warehouse materials and keeps a stock of them at his workshop. When a festival's window opens he puts them up on the colony's buildings, and takes them down again afterwards.
colony_seasons:decorator.skills.desc: Creativity decides how quickly he puts the decorations up, Dexterity how quickly he makes each batch.
com.minecolonies.coremod.jei.decorator: Makes wreaths, garlands and strings of lights from warehouse materials and decorates the colony for its festivals.
com.minecolonies.coremod.setting.tooltip: On: the Decorator makes decorations whenever his stock is low, all year round. Off: he starts only when a festival's decoration window opens.

com.minecolonies.coremod.setting.tooltip: On: the Decorator puts decorations up and looks after them. Off: he puts nothing up (he still makes stock and takes everything down afterwards).
Whether the Decorator hangs wreaths above doors, and the one wreath on the outside wall of a building with no door.
Whether the Decorator hangs garlands beside the doors.
Whether the Decorator hangs lantern strings or fairy lights above the garlands.
Whether the Decorator puts up the decorated tree at the festival marker. A tree that already stands stays until the take-down.
